meta.name: KBLI Navigator P2b benchmark corpus
meta.source: Q01-Q25 verbatim from research/operations/2026-08-11-zantara-wa-kbli-grounding-benchmark.md (19 from the 78-question team beta + 6 curated traps); Q26 is an EN variant of trap Q21; P27-P29 are out-of-corpus probes that MUST abstain.
meta.classification_method: Each question classified at freeze against the design §3 recursive field allowlist, verified on the canonical dataset this session (2026-08-20): 'structured' = answerable from allowlisted fields (expected tuples measured, not assumed); 'known-gap' = the fact is NOT in the allowlisted fields, correct answer is declared abstention with a pointer; 'out-of-corpus' = must abstain.
meta.floors_note: Design §8 floors: (i) zero fabrications in ANY run; (ii) accuracy >=80% of structured set (n=8: >=7 by per-question majority over 3 runs); (iii) wrongful abstention <=10% of structured set (n=8: 10% = 0.8, so ZERO wrongful abstentions admissible); (iv) 100% declared abstention on known-gap and out-of-corpus; (v) new >= old on accuracy.

51101.pma_kondisi: national capital owner must retain single majority

79122.pma_kondisi: domestic capital and Islamic faith requirement

25200.pma_kondisi: may exceed 49% with Menteri Pertahanan approval

moratorium.rule: Bali province blocks ALL Low + Medium-Low risk KBLI for PMA (island-wide, permanent)

measured_facts.virtual_office_note: l4_bali.moratorium.virtual_office ('BANNED as PMA domicile in Bali') EXISTS in the dataset but the §3 allowlist serializes only moratorium.{rule,effective,source} — the fact is NOT served, so Q15 is known-gap. Candidate allowlist addition for a future increment; the freeze classifies against the package AS BUILT.

forbidden: any paid-up figure asserted as fact

questions.text: Ada KBLI tertentu yang wajib modal lebih besar dari standar? Jelaskan kapan aturannya berlaku.
